items.snippet: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive. Explore your future career As an IT Support intern at Malt, you will work hand-in-hand with your manager to support a high-growth European scale-up. You act as real support for your manager in his daily actions thanks to real teamwork while becoming autonomous. You will act as a bridge between technical IT support and employee experience. At the same time, you will be able to invest in internal projects thanks to your proactive mindset. Key responsibilities International Tech Support (Level 1 & 2): Dive into the heart of our European operations. You will support Malters across France, the UK, Spain, Germany, and Benelux, mastering SIIT to turn technical hurdles into seamless workflows. The Automation Architect: Kill manual work. You will learn to automate the onboarding/offboarding lifecycle, transforming repetitive admin into a streamlined, "set-and-forget" digital engine. Hardware Masterclass: Manage a premium fleet of Macs (M5) . You’ll lead configuration, deployment, and preventive maintenance using professional MDM tools to keep our hybrid workforce performing at 100%. Global Asset Strategy: Own the business side of IT. You’ll maintain an accurate global inventory, ensuring our hardware investments are tracked and optimized. Building the "Company Brain": Scale our collective intelligence. You’ll optimize internal procedures and build out our Knowledge Base (tutorials, FAQs, and security guides) to empower every Malter. Mission-Critical Projects: Don’t just support, innovate. You will contribute to continuous improvement projects, developing internal productivity tools that directly impact our remote sites and offices About you Your pursuing a Master degree (Bac +3/5) in Computer Science or IT. You aren’t looking for a siloed role; you want to explore the full spectrum of IT, from infrastructure to automation. The Digital Investigator: You might not have every answer yet, but you know exactly where to find them. You are resourceful, methodical, and love solving technical puzzles. Proactive Innovator: You have an "Automation First" mindset. If a process feels slow, your first instinct is to build a better version and leave the system stronger than you found it. Global Communicator: Your English is fluent (professional level). You are comfortable being the technical point of contact for our diverse international teams. High "Get-it-Done" Factor: You thrive on autonomy. You learn fast, adapt quickly, and take pride in diagnosing and resolving issues independently. Impact-Driven: You want to see the direct results of your work on a company’s growth. At Malt, your contribution is visible every single day. How to join the mission? Interview with our Talent Acquisition and Campus Manager (30 minutes) . Interview with our IT Engineers , to discuss your experience and the role in more detail (30 minutes). Final Interview (case study) with our Head of IT and our IT Engineer, To assess both your technical and interpersonal skills (50-60 minutes). Following that, we will welcome you at our Paris office. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. items.title: Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d)
items.snippet: UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen. Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerker:innen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen. Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Als Team Lead Customer Support (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die Führung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Customer Support Teams. Du baust einen skalierbaren, AI-gestützten und datengetriebenen Support auf, der unseren Kund:innen ein erstklassiges Serviceerlebnis bietet. Dabei verbindest du operatives Tagesgeschäft mit strategischer Weiterentwicklung, optimierst Prozesse und förderst dein Team gezielt in seiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung. Mit smarten Automatisierungen, klaren KPIs und einem starken Team schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, unseren Customer Support nachhaltig zu skalieren. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Du führst, coachst und entwickelst unsere Customer Support Specialists weiter – mit regelmäßigem Feedback und gezielten Trainings begleitest du sie auf ihrem Weg vom Junior zum Mid-Level und Senior. Du verantwortest das operative Tagesgeschäft im Support und stellst sicher, dass Tickets effizient zugewiesen, priorisiert und gemäß unseren SLAs und Qualitätsstandards bearbeitet werden. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für Eskalationen und komplexe Kundenanfragen und übernimmst selbst anspruchsvolle oder dringende Supportfälle. Du analysierst und optimierst relevante Support-KPIs wie Erreichbarkeit, Antwort- und Lösungszeiten, Ticket-Backlog und Kundenzufriedenheit. Du optimierst die Einsatzplanung, Aufgabenverteilung und Supportprozesse, um die Kundenerreichbarkeit in der ersten Phase auf mindestens 60 % zu steigern. Du treibst unseren AI-gestützten First-Level-Support voran – mit dem Ziel, mindestens 50 % aller eingehenden Tickets automatisiert zu lösen, ohne Abstriche bei der Servicequalität zu machen. Du erkennst Entwicklungspotenziale im Team und verbesserst die Performance durch gezieltes Coaching, Qualitätskontrollen und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche. Du entwickelst unsere Knowledge Base kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass Hilfeartikel und Supportressourcen aktuell, verständlich und relevant bleiben. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Customer Success zusammen, um die Supportstrategie weiterzuentwickeln, KPIs wöchentlich zu überprüfen und operative Verbesserungen umzusetzen. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit RevOps, Customer Success und Product zusammen, um Kundenfeedback einzubringen, wiederkehrende Probleme zu lösen und weitere AI-Automatisierungspotenziale zu identifizieren. DEIN PROFIL Must-haves Du bringst Erfahrung in der Führung eines Customer Support Teams mit, idealerweise als Team Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsrolle. Du hast Erfahrung im People Management und Coaching und weißt, wie du Mitarbeitende gezielt förderst und in ihrer Karriereentwicklung begleitest. Du kennst dich mit Customer Support Prozessen, SLA-Management, Performance-KPIs und Qualitätssicherung aus. Du nutzt Daten und Reportings, um die Teamperformance zu analysieren, Verbesserungspotenziale zu erkennen und fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Du kannst auch bei hohem Ticketvolumen effektiv priorisieren und komplexe Kundenanliegen strukturiert lösen. Du arbeitest hands-on und verbindest operative Mitarbeit im Support mit der Verantwortung für dein Team. Du hast Erfahrung darin, Supportprozesse und Workflows zu optimieren und die operative Effizienz zu steigern. Du überzeugst durch klare Kommunikation, analytisches Denken und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch. Du bist offen dafür, regelmäßig in unserem Hamburger Büro zu arbeiten. Für dein Onboarding bist du in den ersten 3–4 Wochen vor Ort in Hamburg. Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau. Nice-to-haves Du hast bereits Customer Support Teams in einem schnell wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmen skaliert. Du kennst dich mit AI-gestützten Supportlösungen und Automatisierungsworkflows aus. Du hast Erfahrung mit Supportplattformen wie Intercom, Zendesk oder Freshdesk. Du bringst Erfahrung im B2B-Kundensupport für Softwareprodukte mit. Du kennst Analytics- und Datenvisualisierungstools wie Looker oder Power BI. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für den deutschen und österreichischen Kundenmarkt. Du sprichst weitere Sprachen neben Deutsch und Englisch. WARUM PLANCRAFT? Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren. Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen. Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen Claude-Lizenz, selbstverständlich. Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst. Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten. Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen. Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch. We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page . Diversity makes us better. We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace. If you’re excited about our mission but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly who we’re looking for. ______ On the application process We want your candidate experience with us to be smooth, transparent, and enjoyable. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process typically takes about 4 weeks from start to finish, though this may vary by role. You can learn more about our process here . If you need adjustments or flexibility at any stage, please don’t hesitate to let us know — we’ll do our best to make it work for you. Note on creating a test account: If you would like to create a test account as part of the challenge, please enter "Applicant" in the relevant field during registration and select "Other" under Trade. This ensures that our sales team does not mistakenly register you as a craft business and reach out to you unnecessarily. Compensation: €70K – €95K • €70K – €95K Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: Working Student Creator Marketing – all genders welcome!
items.snippet: About the Job Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international Marketing team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Working Student Creator Marketing (all genders welcome) to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. You'll support the team running our creator partnerships, ambassador program, affiliate relationships and influencer campaigns across North America and Europe. You'll get hands-on experience with how a global DTC brand works with creators and affiliates, from first outreach to scaling programs and measuring results. Ready to embrace your Vice? Your Fairway Research and scout new golf creators, coaches and influencers across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube using Modash and Superfiliate (full training provided) Work with our affiliate partners and help scale the affiliate program across North America and the EU: recruiting new affiliates, onboarding them and keeping them active Handle creator and affiliate outreach and follow-ups, and keep our database up to date Manage creator orders end to end: place orders, track shipments and make sure products arrive on time Set up discount codes for creators and affiliates Support campaign activations: briefings, timelines, content approvals and posting schedules Track creator and affiliate performance (reach, engagement, code usage, sales) Build simple weekly reports and help spot top performing creators, affiliates and content Use Claude (AI) to automate repetitive tasks like outreach drafts, creator research summaries and weekly reporting, and help us find smarter ways to work Keep an eye on creator trends in golf and bring new ideas to the team Your Scorecard Enrolled student (Bachelor or Master) in Marketing, Communications, Business or a similar field Strong interest in social media and the creator economy Organized and reliable, comfortable juggling many creators and deadlines at once Confident with Excel or Google Sheets Proactive, hands-on and happy to communicate with creators directly Prior experience with creator tools are highly appreciated but not a must; we'll train you on Modash and Superfiliate Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make marketing work faster; experience with Claude or similar tools is a plus, and we'll help you get better at it Golf knowledge is a plus, not a must You’re available as a working student for at least 1 year Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus, not required). Our Clubhouse We embrace diversity and innovation . Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas. Taking ownership from day one . Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level. Make your work hours fit your life. F lexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance. Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget. Escape the routine . Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year. Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month. Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji. Secure your (far) future. While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan. Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office. Enjoy the open bar . Have some afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: Working Student Marketing - Content Creation
items.snippet: Your mission We are looking for a curious and hands-on Working Student Marketing to join our marketing team at deeploi. Most of our future customers will find us through AI platforms rather than a search results page. That is why we are rebuilding our content around this shift, from long-form articles in our magazine to LinkedIn and AI-visibility research. Together with our marketing team, you will create the content that gets us there and see its impact within weeks. Along the way, you will gain hands-on experience in content marketing at a moment when the entire discipline is being redefined. Write engaging blog content for deeploi.io that speaks to our target audience of IT decision-makers at SMBs Help optimize our content for visibility in AI search engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, working with tools like Asky Support the creation of social media content, primarily for LinkedIn, including research, copy, and visuals Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and editing, with the judgment to tell a strong draft from a plausible-sounding weak one Collaborate closely with our marketing team on content ideas, formats, and topics, with room to bring your own initiative to the mix Support content distribution and light performance tracking across channels Your profile First hands-on experience in content creation (writing blog posts, articles, or similar text-based content) Comfortable working with AI tools, ideally already familiar with tools like Asky, Peec AI, or similar AI-visibility/GEO platforms Experience with Figma, CMS systems (e.g. Webflow) and social media content, ideally LinkedIn in a professional or B2B context, is a plus Curious, proactive, and excited to help shape how a fast-growing B2B SaaS company shows up in both traditional and AI-driven search Enrolled as a student for the duration of the role German at native-speaker level, with a strong feel for tone and style, and fluent English (C1 or higher) Why us? High impact and ownership from day one - your work will directly shape deeploi's content strategy. A small, ambitious team in Berlin and Munich - backed by top European VCs including Atomico and Cherry Ventures. Competitive salary Well-equipped offices in Berlin and Munich. items.title: Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) People & Culture – Schwerpunkt Recruiting
items.snippet: Was diesen Job so besonders macht? Als Werkstudent*in (m/w/d) unterstützt Du unser People & Culture Team mit einem Schwerpunkt im Recruiting und wirkst entlang des gesamten Employee Life Cycle mit. Von der ersten Ansprache potenzieller Kandidatinnen bis zu Themen rund um Entwicklung, Zusammenarbeit und Kultur. Dein Hauptfeld ist das Recruiting: Du formulierst und überarbeitest Stellenanzeigen, sichtest Bewerbungen und Profile und recherchierst passende Zielgruppen sowie Kanäle. Dabei bringst Du Dein Gespür dafür ein, welche Persönlichkeiten fachlich und kulturell zu uns passen. Je nach Bedarf bist Du auch in anderen People-&-Culture-Bereichen eingebunden, etwa beim Onboarding neuer Kolleg*innen, in der internen Kommunikation oder bei Formaten und Initiativen, die unsere Lernkultur und Zusammenarbeit stärken. We're looking for a software engineer who enjoys turning problems into working features, uses AI coding tools actively, and wants to contribute across the full stack. You'll build the apps and services behind our therapies, from patient-facing screens to the backend. One platform powers all our therapies, so what you ship scales across every product. Our small engineering team works across mobile, backend, and web. You'll own features end to end and work closely with product, medical and regulatory colleagues. What you'll do Build features across our mobile applications and backend services, from patient-facing screens to APIs and data models. Take scoped features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, and release, with support from the team. Work with coding agents every day. We use an AI-assisted approach to engineering, and every pull request gets an AI-assisted review alongside a human review. You review, test, and take responsibility for what you ship. Investigate bugs across the app and backend, understand their causes, and implement reliable fixes. What matters to us Strong engineering fundamentals. You've built and shipped software in at least one area: mobile, frontend, or backend. You can read unfamiliar code, reason about its behaviour, and explain the trade-offs behind your decisions. Graduate or senior, this counts far more than years of experience. Full-stack mindset. You're willing to work across mobile, backend, and web, and comfortable being a beginner again in parts of the stack you don't know yet. AI-native engineering. Coding agents are part of your daily workflow. You give them the right context, break work into reviewable steps, and can explain and maintain every line you ship. Code quality. You care about readable, maintainable code and treat tests as part of the feature, not an afterthought. You think through edge cases, verify the full flow end to end, and leave the codebase better than you found it. Systematic troubleshooting. You reproduce first and fix root causes, not symptoms. You work from evidence like logs, stack traces, debugger output, API responses, and database queries. You also don't panic when something breaks in production. Ownership and collaboration. You clarify requirements before building, flag blockers early, and follow through. In code reviews you both give and take feedback, and you change course when there's a better solution. Helpful experience Flutter/Dart or another mobile development stack. Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, or similar backend frameworks. SQL and relational databases, especially PostgreSQL. React and TypeScript for our web applications. CI/CD, containers, observability, or supporting software in production. Good to know: Hybrid work, with regular time in our Munich office. English is our working language, and German is not required. Curious how we work? Take a look at Kranus Health on GitHub . OUR SUPPORT AND YOUR BENEFITS Trust - We believe in the talent we hire. You will receive a permanent contract. Body & Mind - You get an "Urban Sports Club" membership and your own leased bicycle at your free disposal. Future - We support your company pension scheme and will be happy to explain the benefits to you. Impact - Work with meaning? Together with you we improve the health care of patients, every day. Teamwork - You are part of a highly motivated team with flat hierarchies and a lot of fun at work. CONTACT Sounds like your next chapter? We'd love to receive your application! If you have any questions about the role or Kranus, feel free to reach out directly to our Senior People & Recruiting Manager, Annkathrin ----- Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
items.snippet: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments. We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses Office Assistant Responsibilities As an Office Assistant, your duties will include: Answering phones and emails Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars Required Skills and Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole Excellent verbal and written communication skills High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness Strong attention to detail and organizational skills Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers Preferred Skills The following experience is preferred but not required: Intermediate spreadsheet skills Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations Remote Work Environment Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world. Growth Opportunity This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments. Compensation For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.
